response.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS phase_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(phase_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.phase_avg) AS average_bandwidth_usage, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS telescope_count, AVG(p.phase_avg - m.mean_phase_avg) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS m WHERE p.phase_avg > m.mean_phase_avg;
